columns.name: POOL_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Pool security profile id uniquely identifies the talent pool security profile.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the security profile entered by user.

columns.name: VIEW_ALL
columns.description: Designate if security profile is defined for view all access.

columns.name: VIEW_ALL_PUBLIC_POOLS
columns.description: Designate if security profile is defined for access of all public talent pools.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Designate if security profile is enabled or not .

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_BUSINESS_UNIT
columns.description: Designate whether to secure by business unit.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_DEPARTMENT
columns.description: Designate whether to secure by department.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_JOB_FAMILY
columns.description: Designate whether to secure by job family.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_OWNER_ONLY
columns.description: Designate whether to secure only by defined owners.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SGUID
columns.description: The seed global unique identifier. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
